q: How much LPG and power do Rajkot investment casting units use, and what goes in a buyer's carbon figure?
title: Rajkot investment casting: LPG and power
short: Rajkot's 110 or so investment casting units used 184 million kWh, 2,610 t of LPG and 8.9 million scm of gas in 2014 to 15 for about 48,000 t of castings. That is about 3 t CO2 per tonne from energy alone, mostly power. A buyer's figure adds the alloy you melt.
audience: Lost wax casting units in Metoda, Bhunava, Kuwadva, Aji and Hadamtala supplying pump, valve and auto makers

ul: About 110 units: about 10 making 70 tonnes a month, most around 40, and about 25 around 10.
About 160 tonnes of castings a day, roughly 48,000 tonnes a year, in stainless steel, carbon steel and brass, mainly for pumps, valves, auto and textile machinery.
About 70% of units bake shells and heat treat on PNG; the rest on LPG.
Melting and shell baking take about 30% of a unit's energy each; cold room air conditioning, compressors and heat treatment take most of the rest.

sections.h: Why the per-tonne figure is so high
ul: Yield is only 40 to 50%: gates, runners and rejects get melted again, so melting takes about 2,000 kWh per tonne of good castings although molten metal needs only 600 to 850.
Ladles are tapped in small lots as shells come ready, so furnaces hold metal hot for 45 to 100 minutes.
Wax rooms run at 22 to 24 degrees C all day: a typical unit has 3 or 4 chillers of about 50 TR.
Units on PNG average about 0.55 toe per tonne of good castings; units on LPG about 0.72.

sections.h: The cluster's CO2 on today's factors
ul: Electricity: 184 million kWh x 0.675 kg = 124,200 t.
Gas: 8.9 million scm x 2.05 kg = 18,250 t.
Total about 150,200 t on 48,000 t of castings: about 3.1 t CO2 per tonne, 83% of it from power. This is energy only, before the alloy.

sections.h: What a pump or valve buyer's figure needs
ol: Your energy per tonne of good castings, as above, from twelve months of bills and dispatch weights.
The metal: kg of alloy melted per kg shipped, with a figure per kg for each grade, such as 304 or 316 stainless, from your bar or scrap supplier.
Wax, ceramic slurry and stucco if the buyer asks for a full product footprint.
Most investment castings ship as pump, valve or machine parts or under 7325, outside CBAM today, so this is a buyer request, not a customs filing. Confirm the CN code.

example.title: Worked example: TERI's typical 500 t a year unit on PNG
lines: Shell baking and heat treatment: 100 toe x 41.868 GJ = 4,187 GJ x 56.1 kg = 235 t
Total: 1,518 t for 500 t of good castings
Energy per tonne: about 3.0 t CO2, before the alloy
Raise yield from 45% to 55% and melting power per good tonne falls by about a fifth
example.note: Energy use is TERI's typical unit. Gas uses the IPCC natural gas default per GJ. The yield line assumes melting power scales with metal melted per good tonne: 45 / 55 = 0.82.

senseible: Send Senseible your PGVCL bills and gas or LPG invoices and it builds the monthly energy and CO2 records; divided by the tonnes you dispatched, that is the energy per tonne a buyer asks for. The alloy figures come from your metal suppliers and sit beside it.
